literal: All having gathered, even those who besieged, position having secured, those who held defeating, (is) a fortress.
translation: A true fortress enables its defenders, holding their secure positions, to defeat even enemies who have laid siege with all their gathered might.
modern: தமக்குரிய இடத்தின் வலிமையை நிலைநிறுத்தி உள்ளே இருப்பவர்கள், தம் முழு வலிமையையும் திரட்டி முற்றுகையிட்ட பகைவரையும் வெல்ல உதவுவதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate defensive power of a fortress. The phrase 'முற்று ஆற்றி முற்றியவர்' refers to enemies who have gathered all their strength to lay a complete siege. Against them, 'பற்று ஆற்றி பற்றியார்' describes the defenders who firmly secure their position inside. A true fortress is one that allows these defenders to defeat such a massive, well-prepared besieging force.
